coverage: All 24 equal-airport score rows, all 12 report-volume groups under two weighting schemes and all eight target standardization rows.
scores: airport_equal_scores.csv averages each airport mean score with equal airport weights. National report-weighted counterparts appear in national_performance.csv. hierarchical_ebl_weighting.csv contains both weightings for the primary national reference.

signs.report_volume_display.csv: Observed minus predicted probability, in percentage points.
signs.report_volume_calibration.csv: Observed minus predicted probability, on the probability scale.
signs.hierarchical_ebl_weighting.csv: Observed minus predicted probability, on the probability scale.
signs.airport_equal_scores.csv: Bias is predicted minus observed probability, in percentage points.

grouping: Separate quantile grouping in each evaluation; ties stay together, yielding six groups. All airports, including zero-damage airports, remain represented.
uncertainty: 2,000 within-group airport resamples of fixed outcomes and predictions. The same sampled airports supply observed and predicted values. Figure intervals are marginal; table gap intervals are paired. Fixed membership and boundaries. Pointwise, with neither development uncertainty nor simultaneous coverage across groups.
overlap: National geographic 2015–2025 and temporal 2024–2025 evaluations overlap in reports and airports; their agreement is descriptive, not independent replication. Report count is not flight exposure.
standardization: Phase, recorded aircraft mass and bird size define national strata. At least 20 national reports from five airports are required; all eight targets are excluded. Supported target weights sum to one. Supported-target proportions use the reports supplying the weights; full-target proportions use all eligible target reports.
unsupported_count_derivation: All reports minus supported reports; deterministic count subtraction only. Other displayed values retain source rounding. No damage count is inferred from rounded percentages.
inference: Standardization is descriptive, carries no confidence interval or causal-adjustment claim, and does not change frozen model predictions. Target score rows cover 2015–2025 under frozen temporal-development models, as retrospective geographic assessment.
